items.label: TRANSFORM CHAIR TO BED
items.value: Looking for stylish and functional furniture? The innovative bean bag chair can be transformed into a bean bag bed, perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, or dorm. Whether you want to relax, work, or nap, this adult bean bag chair is a perfect choice. With this chair bed, you can easily welcome family and friends for a pleasant evening.

items.label: BEAN BAG CHAIR WITH FILLING
items.value: This bean bag chairs for adults is crafted with high-quality colored foam blocks, which means it offers more comfort and support than other lazy chair. Even after sitting for hours, the foam maintains its shape, providing lasting comfort for any activity. The bean bag is tightly squeezed during the journey, giving it 24-48 hours to regain vitality

items.label: SIMPLE ASSEMBLY TECHNIQUE
items.value: After receiving the product, you only need to grab the two diagonal corners of the floor mattress, stuff them into the bean bag cover, and shake them a few times to evenly distribute the beans inside. Pull up the zipper and you'll have a luxury beanbag chair. Therefore, the lounge chair bringing a cozy sleeping experience of futon mattress while offering the relaxed of bean bag chair, making it perfect for rest and leisure.

items.label: WASHABLE & COMFY COVER
items.value: The big bean bag chair cover is made from breathable, high-quality, super-soft fabric that is gentle on the skin. The cover features a discreet long zipper that doesn't compromise the chair's aesthetics, making it easy to put on and take off, and convenient for washing in the washing machine.

items.label: PERFECT FOR ALL FUN
items.value: Bean bag sofa is a companion for balancing work and rest, perfect for game rooms, bedrooms, or basements. Ideal for movie and game nights or quiet reading, it's also a hit with teens and college students for gaming and studying in dorms. It not only adds a sense of fashion to any room, but also provides a thoughtful gift for loved ones who enjoy comfort and relaxation.
